[[T. Alvak]]'s '''father''' was a [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who had served in a variety of posts in [[Gender/Legends|his]] career, including a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] sub-[[Navigator/Legends|navigator]], a [[harbor controller]], and as the senior [[Portmaster/Legends|portmaster]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial base (Tieos)|base]] on [[Tieos/Legends|Tieos]].<ref name="SWS" />
